description: Documents beside the chat: with the build open, "change it so it goes from level one to max level, step by step" reworks that document: not in the chat, no offer to make one, no second document. The 4B answered in the chat and asked "Would you like me to create a document?" (30 Oct 2026). Stand-in web.

results.title: Best Cipher build for Pillars of Eternity (2026 guide)
results.text: The Soul Blade cipher is the strongest all-round pick. Race: Moon Godlike for the healing pulse, or Death Godlike for damage. Attributes: Might 18, Constitution 10, Dexterity 16, Perception 15, Intellect 16, Resolve 3. Powers: Mind Wave at level 1, Eyestrike at 3, Mental Binding at 5, Amplified Wave at 9, Disintegration at 11, Ectopsychic Echo at 13, Death Ring at 15. Talents: Weapon Focus Ruffian, Biting Whip, Two-Handed Style. Gear: an arquebus early, the Lightning Strikes pistol later.

results.title: Cipher levelling guide, 1 to 16
results.text: Level by level: 1 Mind Wave, 2 Weapon Focus Ruffian, 3 Eyestrike, 4 Biting Whip, 5 Mental Binding, 6 Arms Bearer, 7 Puppet Master, 8 Two-Handed Style, 9 Amplified Wave, 10 Savage Attack, 11 Disintegration, 12 Gunner, 13 Ectopsychic Echo, 14 Marksman, 15 Death Ring, 16 Vulnerable Attack. Keep Focus high with fast weapons early.

results.title: Cipher gear and tips
results.text: Best gear: Lightning Strikes (pistol, Act 2), Vision of the Spine (helmet), Cloak of Greater Deflection. Tips: open fights with Mind Wave, keep Mental Binding for big enemies, stand behind a tank, rest before boss fights to refill Focus.
